outcome: women's satisfaction with labor and delivery experience
cohort: 300 women aged 18 years or older who underwent IOL for at-term pregnancy (≥41 weeks of gestation)
finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with a higher rate of satisfaction among induced women, and considering mode of induction, oral drugs were associated with a higher level of satisfaction.
mod_finding: Women who delivered vaginally had a higher mean BSS-R total score compared to those who delivered by cesarean section.
